component.name: Icon
component.description: Renders an icon from a UnoCSS icon class, JSX element, or render function.

own.name: name
own.description:
Icon source. Strings should be Uno icon classes such as `i-lucide-search`
or app-config aliases such as `icon-search`.
Non-string values can be JSX nodes or render functions.

own.name: size
own.description: Icon size. Numbers are interpreted as px.

own.name: title
own.description: Accessible title for the rendered icon element.

aria.name: aria-hidden
aria.description: Hides decorative content from assistive technology.

data.name: data-slot
data.description: Identifies the rendered slot for styling hooks and selectors.
